corrections: (a) 样本量口径【最重要】:修正前「n=12,672」被当作研究样本量 → 修正后「12,672 是参与过调查的 10–15 岁青少年总数,不是任何一个分析的样本量;论文原文紧接着写明『the precise number of participants for any analysis varied by age and whether full or imputed data were used (range, n = 539 to 5,492; median, n = 1,699)』。即分析样本中位数仅 1,699,最大 5,492」。证据:PNAS 116(21):10226–10228 正文第四段(Europe PMC 全文 XML,PMC6534991)。以 12,672 描述该研究的统计效力会夸大约 7 倍。

(c) 统计量口径:修正前「两个纵向效应 β = −0.05 / −0.02」读作模型点估计 → 修正后「这两个是 2,268 个不同分析设定构成的规范曲线(specification curve)的**中位数**,不是单一或首选模型的估计值」。论文原文:『We report standardized coefficients for all 2,268 distinct analysis options considered.』以及 Fig.1 图注说明每个 x 轴点是一种分析决策组合(含 gender、波数、估计量、插补、协变量)。同一段落还给出对应的组间中位相关 ψ = −0.13,引用 β 时若略去 ψ 会遗漏『组间小负相关 vs 组内几乎为零』这一核心对比。
(a) 波数口径:修正前「八波」易被读作每个模型都用了八波 → 修正后「『eight-wave』描述的是数据集本身;波数是规范曲线中的一个分析维度,而论文的 best-practice 聚焦模型明确只用『data from participants who completed four waves』」。

(a) 年份口径(轻微,方向仍成立):正文写 2009–2016,与论断一致;但同文的数据引用(ref 6)写的是『Understanding Society: Waves 1-8, 2009–2017 and Harmonised BHPS: Waves 1-18, 1991–2009』(UKDS doi.org/10.5255/UKDA-SN-6614-12)。论文内部存在 2016 / 2017 的不一致,引用时以正文『2009–2016』为准即可,但不宜声称这是数据集的权威年份窗。

(b) 引语完整性(极轻微):修正前引语以『social media effects are nuanced...』起头 → 论文原句以『Instead,』引导:『Instead, social media effects are nuanced, small at best, reciprocal over time, gender specific, and contingent on analytic methods.』所引片段本身逐字无误,属完整句的子串,建议保留 Instead 或用省略号标示。
evidence_notes: 一手来源:Europe PMC 全文 XML(https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC6534991/fullTextXML),对应 PMC6534991 / PMID 31061122 / DOI 10.1073/pnas.1902058116,PNAS 2019;116(21):10226–10228,CC BY 开放获取。pnas.org 原文对 WebFetch 返回 403,故以 Europe PMC 官方全文 XML 作为一手替代(非二手转述,是出版商存缴的全文)。

(b) 摘要逐字比对通过。原文全句:『In this study, we used large-scale representative panel data to disentangle the between-person and within-person relations linking adolescent social media use and well-being. We found that social media use is not, in and of itself, a strong predictor of life satisfaction across the adolescent population. Instead, social media effects are nuanced, small at best, reciprocal over time, gender specific, and contingent on analytic methods.』待验片段与之逐字一致(含连字符、逗号序列)。

(c) β 句逐字比对通过,一字不差:『Both median longitudinal effects were trivial in size (social media predicting life satisfaction, β = −0.05; life satisfaction predicting social media use, β = −0.02).』负号为 U+2212,与论断一致。

(a) 数据集描述逐字:『we analyzed an eight-wave, large-scale, and nationally representative panel dataset (Understanding Society, the UK Household Longitudinal Study, 2009–2016) using random-intercept cross-lagged panel models』。『eight-wave』『2009–2016』『10- to 15-y-olds』三项均命中。

构念口径提示:社交媒体使用是**单题自报**,原文题干逐字:『How many hours do you spend chatting or interacting with friends through a social website like [Bebo, Facebook, Myspace] on a normal school day?』(5 点量表);生活满意度为 6 个领域陈述(7 点视觉模拟量表);另含 7 个儿童/照料者/家庭层面控制变量。引用『社交媒体使用』时应注意它测的是『与朋友聊天/互动』时长,不是总体社媒使用。

论文自身的限定语(不应在转述中丢失):『Most effects are tiny—arguably trivial; where best statistical practices are followed, they are not statistically significant in more than half of models.』以及性别方向性发现『Only 16% of significant models arose from male data』,并伴随作者自己的告诫『When comparing both genders, the effects' confidence intervals overlap, and the lower incidence of significant effects in males alone is not evidence that the effects are therefore substantial in females』。

反证检索结果:PubMed(efetch, PMID 31061122)显示该文**无勘误(Erratum)、无撤稿(Retraction)、无 Correction 记录**;CommentsCorrections 仅有两条,即 Foster & Jackson 的 letter(PNAS 116(31):15333, doi 10.1073/pnas.1908385116, PMID 31315985)与作者 Reply(PNAS 116(31):15334-15335, doi 10.1073/pnas.1909553116, PMID 31315984)。

Foster & Jackson 的 letter 属**测量效度**批评而非数字推翻:主张单题、且限定为『chatting or interacting with friends』会把重度但非社交型使用者误记为『never』,并称其在测外向性/社交网络规模;认为测量问题『profound and render the results of the study highly confounded』。该批评不改变本论断组待验的三项(样本描述、摘要措辞、β 中位数),但削弱其外推到『社媒使用总量』的解释力。作者 Reply 未修改任何报告数值。

利益相关审查:未发现利益冲突问题。论文脚注逐字『The authors declare no conflict of interest.』;资助方为 Barnardo's UK(儿童慈善机构,A.O. 与 A.K.P.)、Volkswagen Foundation(T.D.)、Understanding Society Policy Fellowship Grant ES/K005146/1(A.K.P.)——均非科技/社媒产业资金,且资助方立场(儿童权益慈善)若有偏倚也应偏向『发现危害』,而结论方向相反,故资助偏倚不构成对结论的威胁。数据与代码公开(UKDS doi 10.5255/UKDA-SN-6614-12;OSF doi 10.17605/OSF.IO/4XP3V)。
文章类型为 PNAS『Brief Report』(全文仅 3 页,10226–10228),无独立 Materials and Methods 章节,方法细节散见正文——引用其方法学细节时需以 OSF 代码与 GitHub 仓库(github.com/OrbenAmy/PNAS_2019)为补充。

corrections: (a) 样本量口径:修正前「n=12,672」被当作分析样本量 → 修正后:12,672 是「参与过」青少年自填问卷的总人数,不是任何一个模型的分析 n。论文原文逐字:"While 12,672 10- to 15-y-olds took part, the precise number of participants for any analysis varied by age and whether full or imputed data were used (range, n = 539 to 5,492; median, n = 1,699)." 即单个模型的分析 n 在 539–5,492 之间,中位数 1,699。引用时应写「12,672 名 10–15 岁青少年参与,单个模型分析 n 中位数 1,699(539–5,492)」。

(c) β 的统计量口径:修正前读起来像两个主模型点估计 → 修正后:这两个 β 是对全部 2,268 种分析设定(specification curve / multiverse)所得系数的**中位数**,不是单一模型结果。论文逐字:"We report standardized coefficients for all 2,268 distinct analysis options considered." 设定维度包含生活满意度分项、性别、波数、估计器、缺失值插补、控制变量。模型族是 random-intercept cross-lagged panel models(RI-CLPM),β 为组内(within-person)标准化效应。

(c) 效应对称性口径补充:−0.05/−0.02 是合并两性后的中位数,论文同时报告效应主要来自女生。逐字:"Only 16% of significant models arose from male data.";男生 "b = −0.08 to −0.04 or β = −0.07 to −0.05",女生 "b = −0.13 to −0.05 or β = −0.09 to −0.04"(除外貌满意度外全部分项)。只引 −0.05 而不提性别差异,会丢掉摘要里 "gender specific" 这个限定语的实证基础。
(a) 年份口径提示:「2009–2016」是论文自身表述(逐字 "Understanding Society, the UK Household Longitudinal Study, 2009–2016"),但论文正文未点明所用的具体 wave 编号;UKHLS 第 8 波实地调查跨到 2016 年之后。引用时照抄论文年份可以,但不宜进一步推论为「数据截至 2016 年底」。

勘误核查:PubMed 记录(https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31061122/,PNAS 2019 May 21;116(21):10226-10228)**未列出任何 Erratum in / Retraction in**,仅列 Comment in 与 Reply。某次网络检索摘要曾声称存在「2019 correction notice」,回溯发现该说法来自一篇无关的 PNAS 更正报道(raphazlab 博客,另一篇论文),对本文不成立 —— 不予采信。

同行反证已检索并核对:Foster & Jackson, "Measurement confounds in study on social media usage and adolescent life satisfaction", PNAS 2019 Jul 30;116(31):15333(PMID 31315985 / PMC6681716)。批评点为测量效度:单题只问「上学日」漏掉周末,且限定于「与朋友聊天/互动」,可能混入外向性与社交网络规模。作者回应:"Reply to Foster and Jackson: Open scientific practices are the way forward for social media effects research"(PMID 31315984)。**该批评针对测量效度,不推翻本组三条描述性论断的任何数字或措辞。**

批评意见(不改数字,但影响论断可用范围):Foster & Jackson 指出社媒测量仅问『normal school day』(漏周末)且限定为『chatting or interacting with friends』,认为会把外向性/社交网络规模混入构念,结论是『profound and render the results of the study highly confounded』。作者回复反驳:用量与 Ofcom(2017)年度报告一致,且周中与周末使用高度相关(引 Trepte & Masur 2015, r = .72),但未提供新分析。
